INDE 190.description: Introduction to the profession and core topics of industrial engineering. Introduction to problem solving, ethics and industrial engineering design and analysis techniques.
INDE 190.subject: INDE
INDE 190.title: Introduction to Industrial Engineering

INDE 291.description: Engineering materials, deformative manufacturing, subtractive manufacturing, additive manufacturing, assembly processes, quality control and productivity; computer aided manufacturing.
INDE 291.subject: INDE
INDE 291.title: Materials Manufacturing

INDE 292.description: Manual components and cognitive aspects of work. Ergonomics and work design methods for increased productivity and improved worker health and safety. Integration of motion and time study with human factors and ergonomics and safety engineering.
INDE 292.subject: INDE
INDE 292.title: Work Design Ergonomics

INDE 391.description: Planning and control of operations in both manufacturing and service industries. Effective management and utilization of resources and the production of cost-effective products and services. Principles, models, and techniques used for production planning and inventory control.
INDE 391.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in MATH 141 or MATH 122; D or better in STAT 201 or higher.
INDE 391.subject: INDE
INDE 391.title: Production Engineering Management

INDE 392.description: Application of operations research to industrial engineering. Algorithmic and practical implementation of mathematical models to describe and/or improve systems and to gain real-time efficiency.
INDE 392.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in MATH 344 and STAT 509.
INDE 392.subject: INDE
INDE 392.title: Operations Research in Engineering

INDE 397.description: Industrial engineering experiments, instrumentation, and analysis and interpretation of data.
INDE 397.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in MATH 142 and D or better in one of the following: CSCE 102, CSCE 106, CSCE 145, CSCE 146, ENCP 201, ECIV 201, EMCH 201, ITEC 104, CSCE 104, or ITEC 352.
INDE 397.subject: INDE
INDE 397.title: Industrial Engineering Laboratory

INDE 460.description: Individual investigation or studies of special topics. Requires contract approval.
INDE 460.subject: INDE
INDE 460.title: Independent Study

INDE 490.description: Quality tools and techniques employed to help prevent defects in engineered products, and to avoid problems when delivering solutions or services to customers.
INDE 490.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in STAT 509 or higher; D or better in INDE 391.
INDE 490.subject: INDE
INDE 490.title: Quality Engineering

INDE 496.description: Methods to analyze and optimize facilities layout and the arrangement and movement of physical resources to support the production and distribution of goods and services.
INDE 496.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in INDE 391.
INDE 496.subject: INDE
INDE 496.title: Facilities Planning Material Handling

INDE 497.description: Open-ended team design experiences that develop the ability to develop, implement, and improve integrated systems that include people, materials, information, equipment, and energy. Real-world experiences and business perspectives.
INDE 497.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in INDE 291, INDE 391, and INDE 392.
INDE 497.subject: INDE
INDE 497.title: Industrial Engineering Capstone Project

INDE 561.description: Content varies and will be announced in the schedule of classes by section title. May be repeated for different topics.
INDE 561.subject: INDE
INDE 561.title: Special Topics in Industrial Engineering

INDE 591.description: Advanced concepts of smart manufacturing: hardware infrastructure, cyber infrastructure, data infrastructure, industrial Internet of things, machine to machine network, machine vision, manufacturing event understanding.
INDE 591.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in INDE 291 or EMCH 377 .
INDE 591.subject: INDE
INDE 591.title: Smart Manufacturing

INDE 593.description: Engineering analysis of the movement, production, and storage of raw materials, work-in-process inventory, finished goods, and services from point of origin to point of consumption or use.
INDE 593.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in INDE 392.
INDE 593.subject: INDE
INDE 593.title: Supply Chain Engineering

INDE 595.description: Discrete event simulation methodology emphasizing the statistical basis for simulation modeling and analysis. Overview of computer languages and simulation design applied to various industrial situations.
INDE 595.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in INDE 392.
INDE 595.subject: INDE
INDE 595.title: Systems Simulation

INDE 764.description: Individual investigation or studies of special topics. Requires contract approval.
INDE 764.subject: INDE
INDE 764.title: Independent Study in Industrial Engineering

INDE 791.description: Current developments in industrial engineering research and practice. Course content varies and will be announced in the schedule of classes by title.
INDE 791.subject: INDE
INDE 791.title: Advanced Special Topics in Industrial Engineering
